# Dancing with the Cosmos
## Scripture
## "The lord has made the heavens his throne; from there he rules over everything." - psalm 103:19
## Reflection
As we gaze up at the celestial ballet, we're reminded of the majestic dance between the planets, stars, and galaxies. The universe is a grand symphony, with each element moving in harmony to the rhythm of God's sovereignty. Just as the planets orbit around the sun, our lives orbit around the throne of God, where He sits in majesty, ruling over all creation. In the midst of life's chaos, we can find comfort in the fact that God is the conductor of the universe, orchestrating every moment to bring glory to Himself.
## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, thank you for the celestial dance that declares your majesty. Help us to move in harmony with your will, surrendering our lives to the rhythm of your sovereignty. May we find comfort in your throne, where you rule over all creation, and may our hearts be filled with wonder and awe at the grand symphony of the universe. As we dance with the cosmos, may we be drawn closer to your heart, and may our lives reflect the beauty and harmony of your creation. In Jesus' name, we pray, amen.
